Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic production-quality mobile starting screen for Korean relationship saju app, working title 가까운 사이. Logical dimensions 390 x 844, natural portrait ratio. Large legible Korean typography, body 18–20px equivalent, buttons 56px or taller. App content only: no device, OS status bar, notch, browser, frame or watermark. Existing attached bird mock is reference for product purpose and readable calm hierarchy only; user explicitly replaces previous mascots with MUCH CUTER BABY TIGERS. Original tiger characters: huge rounded heads, tiny round ears, chubby cheeks, short paws, cream muzzles and bellies, simple round dark brown stripes, expressive dot eyes; friendly, no fangs, no fierce eyes, no known character copying. Two tigers show companionship without assuming romance. Main copy verbatim: 가까운 사이; 나와 이 사람,\n어떤 사이일까요?; 생년월일로 알아보는\n우리 사이의 좋은 점; 내 정보 → 상대 정보 → 우리 궁합; 첫 상대 무료로 보기; 다음 상대부터 1명당 2,900원. Optional secondary nav 내 지도. Do not invent features, fake scores, shopping items, onboarding avatar selection, horoscope predictions. One primary action, whitespace, strong hierarchy, no card nesting or excessive boxes. Max 2 font families. Current date 2026-10-14; no visible dates necessary. Output single finished screen, never multiple panels.
Direction name: 햇살 호랑이. Title-first left-aligned typography in dark cocoa on ivory. Large charming illustration through middle: two squishy orange and pale golden baby tiger cubs sitting side by side in a quiet sunlit wildflower meadow, one gives the other a tiny flower, tails curve gently, soft storybook gouache, simple backdrop to keep cute faces the center. Generous whitespace above. Bottom slim three-step line and generous burnt orange primary button. Warm cream/apricot palette with minimal sage leaf accent. Make the tigers dramatically cuter than reference birds, mascots occupy 35% of screen. Body text exact and uncluttered.

Direction name: 말랑 호랑이. Dramatically different layout from reference: character-first minimalist screen on very pale buttery cream, centered small wordmark at top. Upper middle a huge adorable pair of baby tiger mascots leaning cheeks together, one orange one pale peach, squishy collectible matte-clay 3D illustration with short rounded paws, no photoreal fur, no environment or city. Beneath illustration centered bold rounded cocoa Korean title in two lines, then supporting copy. A compact quiet single-line three-step guide close to bottom primary pumpkin button, generous breathing room. Tangerine, vanilla and chocolate palette. Show characters and main action as the only two emphasis points. Ground product/copy in reference but do NOT copy its scenic layout or leaves.

Direction name: 호랑이 발자국. Flat warm Korean storybook editorial illustration, cream paper surface, burnt orange tigers and forest green action. A DISTINCT airy layout: small wordmark header, large left-aligned title and subcopy at top; below, a charming lightly curved footpath across the middle with two very round baby tiger cubs touching paws, few wildflowers, lots of plain background, absolutely no photo city or detailed landscape. Integrate the three labelled stages '내 정보', '상대 정보', '우리 궁합' as THREE readable checkpoints beneath the characters along the gentle path, to explain the input journey visually, not a relationship score/map. Illustration uses simplified thick soft brown outlines and soft orange fills, cheeks, short limbs, cute oversized heads, like charming contemporary children's picture book art. Deep forest green full-width primary button below with white text. Bottom price clearly readable. Minimal composition, no panels, no metrics. Keep type large and contrast strong. Reference attached establishes copy and product purpose but change hierarchy/composition and drawing style as specified.
